requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: rear-view full-body pixel-art source painting for an editable game character. Reference image 1 is the CURRENT Stone Warden identity; preserve this same character, proportions, armor design, palette, pixel cluster scale, brass outline trim, heavy enclosed pointed helmet, bulky dark green-black plate armor, ragged brown tabard, huge brass-rimmed kite/tower shield, and short heavy studded mace. Draw a coherent rear three-quarter view of this SAME character facing upper-right on a 2:1 isometric board, from the same elevated camera. Helmet back has no eyes or face motif. Shield is held on his left arm, now screen-left, with the BACK of the shield visible (dark wood, brass rim and arm straps), held slightly outboard to expose armored hips and knees. Mace is in right hand, screen-right, hanging diagonally outward beside the leg. Feet are rear/heel views, not front toes; see back plates, back belt, rear skirt/tassets. Neutral grounded stance. One complete assembled character only, no sheet, no labels or shadows, no floor. Pixel art, crisp restrained pixels, same sprite detail as reference, no smooth airbrushing, no glow or spells. Transparent background with actual alpha, full figure uncropped with generous transparent margin. Do not redesign as a stone golem or fantasy giant. Exact same compact knight identity.
requests.disposition: Selected rear visible art. Registered once to native coordinates.
